criteria.criterion: When .vloop/repo-guidelines.md exists in the repository root and is not empty, every session vloop run starts (plan, gate review, work, review) gets `--append-system-prompt-file .vloop/repo-guidelines.md` added to its claude arguments, as one contiguous pair
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/session.go:107 appends the pair in WithGuidelines; session.go:342 routes every Runner.Run through it; TestWithGuidelines asserts the contiguous pair

criteria.criterion: When the file is missing or empty, every session's arguments are exactly today's. Violation: any session's arguments changing when there is no guidelines file
criteria.evidence: session.go:104 returns args unchanged for a missing, non-regular or zero-size file; TestWithGuidelines covers no file and empty file with DeepEqual

criteria.criterion: The flag and its spelling were confirmed against `claude --help`; had it been absent, the task halts and says so instead of guessing
criteria.evidence: the task's notes record the operator's confirmation with Claude Code 2.1.296: the flag is accepted (errors only for a missing file) and a misspelling gives 'unknown option'; the flag is hidden from --help, and the operator's direct test settles the spelling the criterion is after

criteria.criterion: The file is read from the repository root only, never from HOME or any global location; a file over 16 KiB is still handed over whole
criteria.evidence: session.go:104 stats filepath.Join(root, GuidelinesFile) only and passes the path with no size cap; the test writes 20 KiB and still expects the flag

criteria.criterion: The session record is unchanged: no new field in session/v2 or any schema
criteria.evidence: only session.go and session_test.go were touched by the implementation; no schema or record struct changed

criteria.criterion: TestSessionArgs (internal/driver/session_test.go) changes only if the function it calls gains a parameter, and the arguments it pins with no guidelines file do not change; committed tests cover the flag with a non-empty file and its absence with no file and an empty file. Violation: the behaviour shipped with no committed test the checks run
criteria.evidence: Args is unchanged and TestSessionArgs pins the same arguments; TestWithGuidelines covers non-empty (20 KiB), no file and empty file; the go check passed

criteria.criterion: No earlier test is weakened: only the tests the brief's Constraints list change, and only as they state
criteria.evidence: session_test.go change is purely additive (TestWithGuidelines); no existing test altered

notes: The working-tree diff is only .vloop/state/state.json; the implementation from earlier attempts is already in HEAD and was judged there. The brief's wording 'confirmed against claude --help' does not fit a hidden flag; the operator's note supplies equivalent confirmation.
